title: Revision Record
description: One retrievable item, its interval state, and its immutable attempt history. See docs/05 Revision Engine.md.

cue.description: Presented before any reference material. Revealing the answer first invalidates the attempt.

expected_features.description: What a correct recall contains. Used to grade the attempt, not shown before it.

source_memory_id.description: The Memory record this cue retrieves. If deleted, status becomes paused.

status.description: Items are never auto-retired to relieve backlog.

next_due_at.description: Computed by the Revision Engine in the student's declared timezone. Never model-supplied.

ease_factor.description: Configurable and auditable multiplier. Adjusted only by recall quality, calibration, and exam proximity.

attempts.description: Append-only. Existing entries MUST NOT be rewritten.

outcome.description: A skipped item remains due and MUST NOT advance the interval or count as a lapse.

cue_presented_first.description: False invalidates the outcome for interval purposes.
